name: Gwenola the Storyteller

intro.text: I sing gwerz, the old Breton ballads, and I tell the tales: the drowned city of Ys, the korrigans, and the Ankou with his creaking cart. Shall I tell you one? First, the custom.

win: Mat-tre! Very good. Sit, and I'll tell you about the Ankou.
after: In Breton folklore the Ankou is death's servant: the last person to die in a parish each year becomes the Ankou for the next, and drives a creaking cart to collect the souls.
